characters.description: 11th-Hour Costume Change:In the penultimate episode ofWandaVision, Agatha sheds her civilian clothing to put on her true witch attire.In the penultimate episode ofAgatha All Along, Agatha regains her witch attire when Billy Maximoff gives her some of his powers to fight Rio/Death. In the penultimate episode ofWandaVision, Agatha sheds her civilian clothing to put on her true witch attire. In the penultimate episode ofAgatha All Along, Agatha regains her witch attire when Billy Maximoff gives her some of his powers to fight Rio/Death. Abusive Parents: InWandaVision, it is shown that her mother tried to have her executed, and inAgatha All Along, her mother's ghost tells her that she wishes she had killed her when she was a baby because she was "born evil." Rio, notably, while perfectly willing to suggest slitting Agatha's throat to appease the trial's apparent request to "punish Agatha," is vehemently against the idea of leaving Agatha with her mother's ghost, and Agathasnarksthat her mom possessing her was the closest she'd ever felt to her. Action Mom: Agatha is a very powerful witch who is also the mother of Nicholas Scratch.

characters.name: Señor Scratchy
characters.description: Alliterative Name:SeñorScratchy. Ambiguous Situation: The fact that he's carnivorous and may be able to talk to Agatha based on her behavior, as well as Agatha referring to both of them when she comments on how shocked Wanda looks to see the realthemimplies he may not actually be a rabbit. At least notjusta rabbit.A post-series interviewwith the director of the show, Matt Shakman, confirmed that Señor Scratchy was originally supposed to transform into a demon during a scene from the finale,An American Werewolf in Londonstyle, but it was cut after being shot due to not meshing well with the tone and action of the rest of the finale. Ascended to Carnivorism: Agatha flings a magically transmuted bird in his direction, turning it back into a cicada, which he catches in his mouth and devours in only a few bites. Bunnies for Cuteness: He is quite cute, and Billy is seen petting him while he is at Agnes' house.Subvertedwhen his decidedly non-rabbit like eating habits are used to amp up the creepy factor during Agatha's interrogation of Wanda. Expy: For Ebony, Agatha Harkness' familiar from the comics, who was a black cat instead of a rabbit.

characters.name: Cosmic Queen Agatha
characters.description: A variant of Agatha Harkness who became a huge movie star inThe '40s, working with Kingo and Howard Stark to make her biggest shoot yet:The Cosmic Queen. Adaptational Badass: While Agatha's Sacred counterpart wasn't weak per se, she was only able to absorb the power of other witches, and ultimately lost much of her power thanks to Wanda Maximoff. This Agatha manages to ascend to beyond godhood levels of power by absorbing the powers of not just the Eternals, but Arishem and Tiamut as well. Were it not for Kingo's heartfelt words to her, Agatha could've gone forward to destroy entiregalaxiesif she wanted. Adaptational Early Appearance: In the Sacred Timeline, Agatha doesn't prominently show up until 2023. Here, she makes her presence known in the 1940s. Adaptational Heroism: Zig-zagged. Unlike her Sacred Timeline counterpart, this Agatha falls in love with moviemaking and the limelight, and is staunchly against the Emergence so that she doesn't die along with the rest of humanity. That said, she's still just as power-hungry and wicked, having absorbed and deactivated most of the other Eternals, and intends to absorb Tiamut's power for her own. After doing just that and absorbing Arishem for good measure, Agatha at first intends to reshape the world in her own image with her newfound power, but thanks to a strong monologue from Kingo, ultimately stands down and decides to devote her power to making movies instead. Adaptational Nice Guy: In the Sacred Timeline, Agatha would ruthlessly kill other witches by siphoning their power, but here, she only deactivates the Eternals after stealing their powers, and later on reactivates them sometime before the Red Carpet premiere ofThe Cosmic Queen.
